display.purpose: Hero numbers on stat cards. Large, bold, monospace.

mono.purpose: All numeric data values for scannable comparison.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Subtle lift on hover for cards and stat cards.

shadows.name: logo-shadow
shadows.purpose: Green glow under the logo icon.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions. Natural deceleration.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: Slightly snappier easing for interactive feedback.

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Metric display card for dashboard stats. Shows label + large mono value.
components.css: .ds-stat-card { background: #1f1f23; border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-stat-card:hover { background: #27272c; border-color: #3f3f46; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 0.7rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #52525b; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-stat-value { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 1.875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.1; color: #fafafa; } .ds-stat-value.green { color: #22c55e; }

components.name: Chart Card
components.description: Container for Chart.js visualizations with header and chart area.
components.css: .ds-chart-card { background: #1f1f23; border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.5rem; } .ds-card-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; color: #a1a1aa; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-chart-container { position: relative; height: 280px; }

components.name: Ranking Item
components.description: Horizontal list item showing repo name, rank position, and CO2 value.
components.css: .ds-ranking-item { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0.875rem 1rem; background: #18181b; border-radius: 8px; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.15s; cursor: default; } .ds-ranking-item:hover { background: #27272c; transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-ranking-info { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; min-width: 0; } .ds-ranking-position { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; color: #52525b; width: 24px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-ranking-name { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #fafafa; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-ranking-value { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; color: #a1a1aa; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Logo Icon
components.description: Green gradient icon with sun/circle motif representing carbon/energy.
components.css: .ds-logo-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #22c55e, #16a34a); border-radius: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(34,197,94,0.25); } .ds-logo-icon svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; }

components.name: Empty State
components.description: Text-only empty state with relevant icon. No illustrations or mascots.
components.html: No deployment data yet
components.css: .ds-empty-state { text-align: center; padding: 4rem 2rem; color: #52525b; } .ds-empty-state svg { width: 56px; height: 56px; margin-bottom: 1rem; opacity: 0.4; } .ds-empty-state p { font-size: 0.9rem; max-width: 280px; margin: 0 auto; line-height: 1.6; }

narrative.overview: A data-forward dashboard that feels like a well-configured terminal: dark, calm, monospaced precision. The interface steps back so the numbers speak. Every element earns its place by displaying or organizing data. Not a greenwashing landing page, not an AI dashboard with gradient meshes. A developer tool for developers who care about sustainability.
keyCharacteristics: Dark zinc background with forest-green primary accent
Staggered entrance animations that clarify hierarchy
Hover states that lift subtly without announcing themselves
Zero illustrations; empty states are text-only

rules.name: The Restrained Green Rule
rules.body: The primary accent appears on ≤10% of any given screen. Green text on green backgrounds is forbidden.

rules.name: The Mono-Data Rule
rules.body: Every numeric value that a user might compare, sort, or scan is rendered in JetBrains Mono.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No shadows at rest. Elevation comes from tonal contrast and motion, not artificial depth.

dos: Do use monospace for all numeric data values (JetBrains Mono)
Do keep the primary green accent under 10% of any screen area
Do use entrance animations with staggered delays for visual hierarchy
Do use ease-out-quart or ease-out-quint for all transitions
Do include direct value tooltips on charts
donts: Don't use gradient meshes or AI-style decorative backgrounds
Don't use neon greens (#00ff00), electric blues, or purple plasma effects
Don't use the hero metric card pattern (big number + small label + gradient)
Don't use cute illustrations or mascots in empty states
Don't use border-left as a colored stripe accent
Don't use bounce or elastic easing curves
